package interoperability_test

import (
	"context"
	"io/fs"
	"strings"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/faustbrian/golib/pkg/outbox"
	outboxpostgres "github.com/faustbrian/golib/pkg/outbox/postgres"
	workflow "github.com/faustbrian/golib/pkg/workflow"
	workflowpostgres "github.com/faustbrian/golib/pkg/workflow/postgres"
	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5/pgxpool"
	tcpostgres "github.com/testcontainers/testcontainers-go/modules/postgres"
)

func TestWorkflowAndOutboxShareOneAuthoritativeCommit(t *testing.T) {
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 3*time.Minute)
	defer cancel()
	container, err := tcpostgres.Run(ctx, "postgres:18-alpine",
		tcpostgres.WithDatabase("workflow"),
		tcpostgres.WithUsername("workflow"),
		tcpostgres.WithPassword("workflow"),
		tcpostgres.BasicWaitStrategies(),
	)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("start PostgreSQL: %v", err)
	}
	t.Cleanup(func() {
		cleanupCtx, cleanupCancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 30*time.Second)
		defer cleanupCancel()
		if terminateErr := container.Terminate(cleanupCtx); terminateErr != nil {
			t.Errorf("terminate PostgreSQL: %v", terminateErr)
		}
	})
	connection, err := container.ConnectionString(ctx, "sslmode=disable")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("PostgreSQL connection string: %v", err)
	}
	pool, err := pgxpool.New(ctx, connection)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("connect PostgreSQL: %v", err)
	}
	t.Cleanup(pool.Close)
	if _, err := pool.Exec(ctx, "CREATE SCHEMA workflow"); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("create workflow schema: %v", err)
	}
	for _, migration := range workflowpostgres.SchemaMigrations() {
		if _, err := pool.Exec(ctx, migration.Up); err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("apply workflow migration %d: %v", migration.Version, err)
		}
	}
	entries, err := fs.ReadDir(outboxpostgres.Migrations(), ".")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("read outbox migrations: %v", err)
	}
	for _, entry := range entries {
		migration, readErr := fs.ReadFile(outboxpostgres.Migrations(), entry.Name())
		if readErr != nil {
			t.Fatalf("read outbox migration %s: %v", entry.Name(), readErr)
		}
		contents := string(migration)
		upMarker := "-- +migrations Up\n"
		downMarker := "-- +migrations Down\n"
		down := strings.Index(contents, downMarker)
		if !strings.HasPrefix(contents, upMarker) || down < len(upMarker) {
			t.Fatalf("outbox migration %s has invalid directives", entry.Name())
		}
		if _, execErr := pool.Exec(ctx, contents[len(upMarker):down]); execErr != nil {
			t.Fatalf("apply outbox migration %s: %v", entry.Name(), execErr)
		}
	}

	workflowStore, err := workflowpostgres.New(pool, workflowpostgres.Config{})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("construct workflow store: %v", err)
	}
	outboxWriter, err := outboxpostgres.NewWriter(outboxpostgres.WriterConfig{Schema: "workflow"})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("construct outbox writer: %v", err)
	}
	now := time.Date(2026, 8, 11, 14, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
	definition, err := workflow.NewDefinition(workflow.DefinitionSpec{
		Name: "orders", Version: "1", Mode: workflow.Choreography,
		Steps: []workflow.StepSpec{{
			Name: "approved", Kind: workflow.StepSignal, Target: "orders.approved",
			Timeout: time.Hour, InputLimit: 64,
		}},
	})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("construct definition: %v", err)
	}
	startEvent, err := workflow.NewHistoryEvent(workflow.HistoryEventSpec{
		Sequence: 1, InstanceID: "order-1", Kind: workflow.EventInstanceStarted,
		OccurredAt: now, Definition: definition.Reference(),
	})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("construct start event: %v", err)
	}
	start, err := workflow.NewTransition(workflow.TransitionSpec{
		ID: "start-order-1", InstanceID: "order-1", Definition: definition.Reference(),
		Events: []workflow.HistoryEvent{startEvent},
	})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("construct start transition: %v", err)
	}
	envelope := outbox.Envelope{
		ID: "publish-order-1", Topic: "orders.started", Payload: []byte(`{"order_id":"order-1"}`),
		PayloadVersion: 1, OrderingKey: "order-1", IdempotencyKey: start.ID(),
		Metadata:    map[string]string{"tenant_id": "tenant-1", "correlation_id": "correlation-1"},
		AvailableAt: now, CreatedAt: now,
	}

	stage := func(commit bool) {
		t.Helper()
		tx, beginErr := pool.Begin(ctx)
		if beginErr != nil {
			t.Fatalf("begin shared transaction: %v", beginErr)
		}
		defer func() { _ = tx.Rollback(ctx) }()
		if stageErr := workflowStore.Stage(ctx, tx, start); stageErr != nil {
			t.Fatalf("stage workflow transition: %v", stageErr)
		}
		if insertErr := outboxWriter.Insert(ctx, tx, envelope); insertErr != nil {
			t.Fatalf("stage outbox envelope: %v", insertErr)
		}
		if commit {
			if commitErr := tx.Commit(ctx); commitErr != nil {
				t.Fatalf("commit shared transaction: %v", commitErr)
			}
		}
	}
	stage(false)
	assertDurableCounts(t, ctx, pool, 0, 0)
	stage(true)
	assertDurableCounts(t, ctx, pool, 1, 1)
	var tenantID, correlationID, orderingKey, idempotencyKey string
	if err := pool.QueryRow(ctx, `
SELECT metadata->>'tenant_id', metadata->>'correlation_id', ordering_key, idempotency_key
FROM workflow.outbox_messages WHERE id = $1`, envelope.ID).Scan(
		&tenantID, &correlationID, &orderingKey, &idempotencyKey,
	); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("read propagated outbox metadata: %v", err)
	}
	if tenantID != "tenant-1" || correlationID != "correlation-1" ||
		orderingKey != "order-1" || idempotencyKey != start.ID() {
		t.Fatalf("propagated outbox metadata = %q %q %q %q", tenantID, correlationID, orderingKey, idempotencyKey)
	}

	signal, err := workflow.NewSignalAcceptance(workflow.SignalAcceptanceSpec{
		InstanceID: "order-1", ExpectedSequence: 1, Definition: definition,
		StepName: "approved", SignalID: "message-1", ReceivedAt: now.Add(time.Second),
		Payload: []byte("approved"),
	})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("construct inbound signal: %v", err)
	}
	if err := workflowStore.Commit(ctx, signal); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("commit signal before acknowledgement: %v", err)
	}
	if err := workflowStore.Commit(ctx, signal); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("deduplicate redelivered signal: %v", err)
	}
	query, err := workflow.NewHistoryQuery(workflow.HistoryQuerySpec{InstanceID: "order-1", Limit: 3})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("construct history query: %v", err)
	}
	page, err := workflowStore.History(ctx, query)
	if err != nil || len(page.Events()) != 2 || page.Events()[1].IdempotencyKey() != "message-1" {
		t.Fatalf("durable deduplicated signal = %#v, %v", page, err)
	}
}

func assertDurableCounts(t *testing.T, ctx context.Context, pool *pgxpool.Pool, workflows, envelopes int) {
	t.Helper()
	var workflowCount, envelopeCount int
	if err := pool.QueryRow(ctx, "SELECT count(*) FROM workflow.workflow_instances").Scan(&workflowCount); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("count workflow instances: %v", err)
	}
	if err := pool.QueryRow(ctx, "SELECT count(*) FROM workflow.outbox_messages").Scan(&envelopeCount); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("count outbox envelopes: %v", err)
	}
	if workflowCount != workflows || envelopeCount != envelopes {
		t.Fatalf("durable counts = workflows %d envelopes %d, want %d and %d", workflowCount, envelopeCount, workflows, envelopes)
	}
}
